description: Converts a date between the Gregorian calendar and the Vietnamese lunar calendar (with leap months, 1900–2100), and gives the can chi of the day, month and year plus the solar term.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; for lunar_to_solar this is the lunar year, month and day

leap_month.description: lunar_to_solar only: true if the lunar month is a leap month

name: convert_lunar_solar
title: Convert lunar and solar dates
